player_prompt.intro:
Ikaw so Player {player_id} ed Wild Tic Tac Toe.
No ontan mo so turn, makapalit ka na saray 'X' o 'O' ed blanko a kuadrado.
Nanalo ka no ontan mo so talo iray atlo a magagaya a marka (X o O) ed row.
Nanalo ka met ed saray duwa a simbolo.
Piliyam so move mo gamen so format '[X 4]' tapno makapalit ka X ed sentro.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Say format na move ekal na sala. Gawisen so '[X 4]' o '[O 2]' a format.
invalid_move.invalid_cell: Invalid cell number: {cell}. Nepeg ya walad baetan na 0 tan 8.
invalid_move.already_occupied: Invalid move. Cell {cell} so busy la.

game_action.placed: Say Player {player_id} napanek na saray simbolo ({mark}) ed cell {cell}

outcome.win: Say manlalaban a {player_id} so analo ed saray {mark}!
